meta.name: writing-guidelines
meta.description: Review docs/prose for Writing Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my docs", "check writing style", "audit prose", "review docs voice and tone", or "check this page against the writing handbook".

copy.tagline: 检查文档是否符合写作规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保文档遵循统一的写作指南
copy.tagline_en: Check docs for writing guidelines compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure docs follow a writing handbook

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会从指定网址获取最新写作规范，然后检查你指定的文件，找出不符合规范的地方，并以“文件名:行号”的简洁格式输出结果。
howto.when: 当你要求“检查我的文档”、“审核写作风格”、“审查文案语气”或“对照写作手册检查这个页面”时触发。

say.text: 检查我的文档是否符合写作规范。
say.note: Claude 会要求你指定文件，然后进行审核。

say.text: 审核这个页面的语气和风格。
say.note: Claude 会获取最新规范并检查指定页面。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude fetches the latest writing guidelines from a specified URL, reads the files you specify, checks them against all rules, and outputs findings in a concise 'file:line' format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'review my docs', 'check writing style', 'audit prose', 'review docs voice and tone', or 'check this page against the writing handbook'.

say_en.text: Review my docs for writing guidelines compliance.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for files and then review them.

say_en.text: Check the tone and style of this page.
say_en.note: Claude fetches latest guidelines and checks the page.
